title: Your Mac’s music, on your Lock Screen.
summary: Playback controls and progress at a glance, more useful shortcuts, and a more dependable connection from away. Update both the Mac and iPhone apps together.

changes.title: Now Playing on the Lock Screen
changes.text: See your Mac’s music or video on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island, with artwork, playback progress, and play, pause and skip controls that work while the iPhone is locked.

changes.title: A card that starts when music does
changes.text: Your Mac can start and update Now Playing while PocketDesk is closed. Choose a card style, hide artwork or skip buttons, end the card when paused, or keep song details out of push notifications.

changes.title: More useful shortcuts
changes.text: Type text, copy it to your Mac, quit apps, lock the Mac, sleep its display, change dark mode or take a screenshot. Add date and time placeholders, ask before running, bind a shortcut to one Mac, or share it for someone to review and save.

changes.title: Check the relay from Settings
changes.text: Remote Access now checks whether your iPhone can reach its configured relay, with a retry button and support for custom servers.

changes.title: Keep Now Playing up to date
changes.text: The Mac sends playback progress and privacy-aware Live Activity updates, prioritizes play and pause changes, and attempts to end the card before sleeping or shutting down.

changes.title: Reconnect to the relay sooner
changes.text: A restarted Mac replaces its old relay connection immediately. Remote Access settings also offer a retry when the relay is unavailable.
